Conservative photographic cleanup: clean neutral satin-silver outer ring, VERY PALE low-saturation cream-beige champagne-gold centre and pure white background matching references. Remove blotchy dirt and uneven colour casts only from flat metal. Preserve EVERY original engraved line and shape, all inscriptions/accents/spacing, dates, mint marks, initials, rim, orientation and all twelve stars EXACTLY. Follow source pixels; never guess unreadable letters or invent details. Keep original relief shading and complete coin outline with modest white margin. No redesigned relief, simplified geometry, new lettering or extra stars. One coin only, no collage, no saturated yellow or mirror chrome. Target: World Youth Day. Lock the original central cross, every abstract participant/circle/head/body/arm, lower supporting hands and small shield. Preserve JORNADA MUNDIAL DA JUVENTUDE, LISBOA 2023, PORTUGAL and all tiny mint/designer lettering exactly. Keep each figure's count, outline and placement; no added people, fingers or altered cross proportions.
